violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink
violation_type.typical_finding: The hand washing sink in the infant classroom was observed being used to clean pacifiers as well as prepare bottles.

finding_variants.text: The hand washing sink in the infant classroom was observed being used to clean pacifiers as well as prepare bottles.
I observe feeding bottles and training cups inside the hand-washing sink. Note: corrected at inspection.
Based on information gathered through inspection, the operation has been using the hand washing sink to prepare bottles.
The handwashing sink was observed being used to rinse eating utentils and plates.
Observed a caregiver washing bottles in both sinks, hand washing and bottle washing sink.
Caregiver declared washing bottles and hands in the same sink.
